preprocessing_required.shortcut_for_mediapipe_tasks: Use mp.Image(SRGB, uint8_array) — runtime handles preprocessing via TFLite metadata.

outputs.name: locations_raw
outputs.note: Anchor-encoded box deltas. Decode via anchors in TFLite metadata (or mediapipe Tasks).

outputs.name: class_logits
outputs.note: Per-anchor [background, leaf] logits. Apply sigmoid (sigmoid_score=False per metadata).

postprocessing.note_mobile: mediapipe-model-maker exports raw SSD output; NMS is NOT in the graph. Mobile must do anchor decode + NMS in JS, OR use a mediapipe Tasks runtime (bindings exist for iOS/Android but not React Native out of the box). Anchors and decode params live in the TFLite metadata block.

benchmarks._note_mobile_latency: Awaiting on-device benchmarks; will be filled by mobile QA pass.

uplift.recommendation: DO NOT integrate cascade for production. Detector-tightest-crop hurts classifier F1 by 11pp vs center crop on 58-image dedup'd sample. Hypothesis: classifier was trained on PlantVillage tight single-leaf images; tighter crops on PlantDoc field images may zoom past whole-leaf shape that the classifier needs for species identification. The detector itself works (mAP@0.5=0.83); the cascade hypothesis was wrong on this dataset. Possible follow-ups: train classifier on detector-cropped data, multi-leaf voting, no padding.
uplift.padding_sweep_note: Monotonic improvement as padding rises (smaller detector influence = less damage). No ratio crosses the +5pp gate. Confirms cascade-fails-here, not threshold-tuning-issue.

training.spec_note: SSD-MobileNetV2 320x320. Brief permits this in lieu of EfficientDet-Lite0; mediapipe-model-maker dropped EfficientDet-Lite specs from its object_detector module. Same 4-tensor output schema, same 320x320 uint8 input, same on-device runtime.
